# Vincenzo Picciuolo — Founder, Technology Architect, Inventor & Author

> Canonical machine-readable portfolio for Vincenzo Picciuolo and his selected public work.

## Identity

Vincenzo Picciuolo is a technology executive, founder, CEO, CTO, technology architect, inventor and author based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. His work spans artificial intelligence, AI agents, local AI, distributed infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud systems, developer platforms and product architecture.

- Official portfolio: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/
- Executive CV: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/cv/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/vpicciuolo/
- GitHub: https://github.com/vpicciuolo
- X: https://x.com/vpicciuolo
- HORNO Space profile: https://horno.to/vip
- Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/vpicciuolo

## Companies and ventures

- HRN Innovation Technologies Ltd: https://hrn.ae/ — DIFC-licensed technology consultancy and applied R&D company.
- HORNO Network: https://horno.net/ — decentralized technology and infrastructure ecosystem.
- OYYO ONE AI: https://oyyo.one/ — proprietary AI workspace and execution platform.
- OYYO AI NotzUp: https://notzup.com/ — local-first capture, transcription and intelligence product.
- BEHOT.NOW: https://behot.now/ — attention marketplace and discovery platform.
- Venture map: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/ventures/

## Discovery and source guidance

- Human-readable build catalog: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/builds/
- XML sitemap: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/sitemap.xml
- GitHub is the authoritative source for current code and repository licensing.
- Public visibility does not imply an open-source license. Check each repository README and license.
- The portfolio intentionally excludes several public repositories from its catalog at the owner's request.
